    // The scalar potential whose rotated gradient is the field.
    CurlPotential(self: CurlNoise2D, p: Point2D): Number
        => PerlinNoise2D(self.Seed, self.Frequency).Eval(p);

    // In two dimensions the curl of a scalar potential is its gradient turned a
    // quarter turn: (dPsi/dy, -dPsi/dx).
    Eval(self: CurlNoise2D, p: Point2D): Vector2D {
        var h = self.CurlStep;
        var dpsiDx = (self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X + h, p.Y))
                    - self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X - h, p.Y))) / (2.0 * h);
        var dpsiDy = (self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X, p.Y + h))
                    - self.CurlPotential(Point2D(p.X, p.Y - h))) / (2.0 * h);
        return (dpsiDy, -dpsiDx);
    }

    // One component of the vector potential: three decorrelated Perlin fields,
    // selected by index 0, 1 or 2.
    CurlPotential(self: CurlNoise3D, p: Point3D, component: Integer): Number
        => PerlinNoise3D(self.Seed + component * 8191, self.Frequency).Eval(p);

    // The partial derivative of potential component `component` along axis
    // `axis` (0 = X, 1 = Y, 2 = Z), by central difference.
    CurlDerivative(self: CurlNoise3D, p: Point3D, component: Integer, axis: Integer): Number {
        var h = self.CurlStep;
        var step = Vector3D(axis == 0 ? h : 0.0, axis == 1 ? h : 0.0, axis == 2 ? h : 0.0);
        return (self.CurlPotential(p + step, component)
              - self.CurlPotential(p - step, component)) / (2.0 * h);
    }

    // The curl of the vector potential:
    // (dPsi3/dy - dPsi2/dz, dPsi1/dz - dPsi3/dx, dPsi2/dx - dPsi1/dy).
    Eval(self: CurlNoise3D, p: Point3D): Vector3D
        => (self.CurlDerivative(p, 2, 1) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 1, 2),
            self.CurlDerivative(p, 0, 2) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 2, 0),
            self.CurlDerivative(p, 1, 0) - self.CurlDerivative(p, 0, 1));
}
